messages:
Alex: hey team — unexpected thing, need to hop offline for ~4h starting now. can someone take primary for the rest of the night? I'm currently primary until 06:00 UTC. :wave:
Morgan: can do partial, but i've got a scheduled db maintenance at 02:30-03:00 that might clash with any pager storms. i can cover 23:00-02:00 though.
Alex: thanks. goal is just continuous primary coverage until i return. there's a small window 02:00-03:30 that's sticky.
Priya: i can pick up the 02:00-06:00 block if that helps. not on-call tonight normally but cross-trained for embeddings & serving. happy to shadow primary. @morgan are you okay handing off at 02:00 exactly?
Morgan: yep that works. i'll stay until 02:00 and do a handoff. Priya if you want a quick shadow checklist, ping me and i'll DM.
Jamal: heads up — we have an ongoing perf alert for embeddings-serve that spikes around midnight sometimes. if pages come in, check the "embed-latency" dashboard and the caching layer (kv-cache) hit rate first.
Casey: leaving runbook snippet here for quick ref:```\nRunbook: primary->secondary handoff checklist\n1) Check /dashboards/embed-latency for >200ms  p50->p99 slope\n2) Look at kv-cache hit rate: service/kv-cache/hit_rate\n3) If >30% error or sustained latency, escalate to infra-team and run redeploy fastroll: infra/deploys/quick-restart\n4) For customer-impacting degraded responses, open incident (severity: P2) and notify CS via #customer-impact\n```
Alex: thanks @casey — copying that into my notes. also leaving credentials/links in the handback doc: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-handback (team-only).
Oncall-bot: Note: Alex marked himself OOTO for 4 hours. Primary assignment updated: Morgan (23:00-02:00), Priya (02:00-06:00).
Priya: quick Q — any special escalation for Dedicated customers vs Hosted? i know Dedicated has a separate SLA matrix.
Jamal: yes — Dedicated customers escalate at P1 for regional outage; for perf regressions that only affect Hosted, use P2. if in doubt, tag both infra and sales-ops. escalation tags: @infra-team @sales-ops.
Morgan: i'll DM Priya a quick walkthrough of the embed rollback steps and where to find recent deploy IDs. also i'll leave a pinned note in the handoff doc with the current pager thresholds and last 3 incidents.
Alex: leaving one more note — there's a planned cluster drain tomorrow 04:00 UTC for GPU pooling. Priya you might see increased scheduling latency. If you see queue backlog > 6000 tokens, escalate.
Priya: got it, noted queue threshold. i'll be online and will run through the runbook if something trips.
Casey: small operational tip: if you need to temporarily mute noisy repeated alerts, use `/alert silence <alert-name> 30m` but only after confirming it's noise w/ metric check. otherwise don't silence until infra agrees. :no_entry_sign:
Oncall-bot: Reminder: handover complete once both primary and secondary confirm. Morgan and Priya, please respond with :thumbsup: when ready.
Morgan: :thumbsup: i'll post a 5-min pre-handoff message at 01:55 UTC with the link to the current traces.
Priya: :thumbsup: i will be ready at 02:00 UTC. DM me if anything urgent before then.
Alex: huge thanks all — appreciate the swap. i'll check in once i'm back online.
